definitions.gloss: to be born and raised (in a place)
definitions.explanation: To be born somewhere and grow up there too. Used with に or で for the place, very often in the past: 〜で{生|う}まれ{育|そだ}った.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{生|う}まれ{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I was born and raised in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{生|う}まれ{育|そだ}った⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{泳|およ}ぎ→泳ぎ：02626_oyogi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: I grew up by the sea, so I'm a good swimmer.

examples.japanese: {生|う}まれ{育|そだ}った⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: It has been ten years since I left the town where I was born and raised, but I still dream of it sometimes.

notes:
⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧ (to be born) + ⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ (to grow up). A godan, intransitive verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{生|う}まれ{育|そだ}つ: to be born and raised in ~
- {生|う}まれ{育|そだ}った⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: the town where one grew up
- 〜⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧〜⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧: born in ~, raised in ~ (as in ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧: one's home area
- ⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧: hometown
